title: Agnus Dei (Johannes Okeghem, Missa Prolationum)
desc: Johannes Okeghem, Missa Prolationum, Agnus Dei. 4 voices (Discantus 1, Discantus 2, Contra 1, Contra 2), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Oke1011e); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
